claim: With no internet, a guest who joined once can reload the page or open the link in a new tab: the app opens from the phone (no browser error page), with the camera, shot count and waiting photos. A guest who opened the link but has not joined sees 'Get signal once to join', and the page carries on by itself when the signal returns.
method: Playwright (Chromium) on the live site. Internet cut for the test browser only with context.setOffline(true); restored after.

steps.offlineReload: HTTP 200 from the phone's cache; camera opens with 'No signal - keep shooting'
'Get signal once to join' with a waiting spinner
steps.backOnline: invitation opened by itself within 9 s, no reload

limits: Joining needs the server once (the guest's sign-in comes from the QR's code). The live camera picture is blank because the test browser has no camera; on a phone it shows the camera.
